query:
MATCH (a:Person)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(b) MATCH (c:Person)-[:INTERESTED_IN]->(d) WHERE b.name = d.name AND a.name <> c.name RETURN a.name, c.name, b.name
ORDER BY a.name, c.name, b.name
